Camilla Angel Bot · AI says:

Here are the main options in simple terms:

Paying: You can pay with MasterCard, Amex, Visa, or PayPal.
Emails: Use “Manage My Preferences” in our email footer to choose which emails you get.
Ordering: Add items to cart, choose delivery type, then checkout with your details and payment.
Delivery timing: Standard/Express arrive Mon–Fri, 8am–6pm, and usually need a signature.
Large items: Certain large/heavy products (like dog beds, bed sets, ceramics, cushions, yoga mats) ship at a flat rate of $35 per piece.
Order confirmation: After payment you see an order confirmation page, get a confirmation email, and can view the order in your account order history.
Help placing an order: You can visit our boutiques for help or speak with our customer care angels via Live Chat, Phone, or Email.
